title: DEA Federal Register registrant-action annual summary
description: Annual counts of DEA Federal Register NOTICE documents classified as registrant administrative actions, 2006-2014. `action_count` is the dedupe'd total registrant actions (revocations, ISOs, settlements, admonitions, OTSCs, other registrant actions). NON_ACTION items (scheduling, quotas, importer/manufacturer registrations, info collections) are excluded. `by_type` gives the per-action-type breakdown used for tooltips; `notable_actions` surfaces a small set of representative FR notices with live links. Source: federalregister.gov/api/v1. See pipeline/notes/dea-investigation-2026-05-01.md.
